The '''Wyrick Index''' was a measurement system devised by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Demagol]],<ref name="Secret Journal">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/demagol/index.html?page=1|text="The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol"|int=The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol (article)|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] Antos Wyrick,<ref name="Demon">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Demon]]''</ref> used to determine an individual's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]].<ref name="Secret Journal" />
